Mustache cheatsheet
SyntaxWhat it doesExample
{{name}}Variable (required){{file}} → main.go
{{name=val}}Variable with default{{tone=concise}} → concise
{{! text }}Comment (ignored){{! TODO: add more }}
{{#list}}...{{/list}}Section (repeat block){{#files}}Review {{.}}{{/files}}
{{^list}}...{{/list}}Inverted section (if empty){{^files}}No files{{/files}}
{{> partial}}Include another template{{> header}}
{{{name}}}Unescaped output{{{html}}} → raw HTML
{{&name}}Unescaped (alt syntax)Same as {{{name}}}
